description.zh: 预定时返回的资源批次号。
description.en: The resource batch ID returned during reservation.

descriptions.zh:
当释放任务成功时，消息通知如下： | 名称 | 类型 | 是否必选|说明| | ------ | ------ | ------ | ------ | | resBatchId |String | 是 |容器异步释放任务ID。| | success |Boolean | 是 |释放是否成功。
取值：
true：释放成功。
false：释放失败。|
descriptions.en:
When the release job succeeds, the following message notification is sent: | Name | Type | Required | Description | | ------ | ------ | ------ | ------ | | resBatchId | String | Yes | The asynchronous container release job ID. | | success | Boolean | Yes | Indicates whether the release succeeded.
Valid values:
true: The release succeeded.
false: The release failed. |
